description: This file is a PHP source file defining the Shipping controller class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles shipping-related actions such as displaying shipping options, providing shipping quotes, and saving the selected shipping method during the checkout process.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: The Shipping controller class manages the checkout shipping process, including displaying shipping options, generating quotes, and saving selected methods.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the shipping options view if shipping is enabled and applicable; otherwise, returns an empty string.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Provides a shipping quote based on the provided address details, validating inputs, and returning available shipping methods or errors in JSON format.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the selected shipping method in the session and returns success or error messages in JSON format.
